chunks: And with this chain of narrators, he said:
Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said: 'Three things one of you should not expose himself to while fasting: the bathhouse, phlebotomy (blood-letting), and a beautiful woman.'

key_terms.يَعرِضُ: To expose oneself or present oneself

ai.seo_question: What are the three things a Muslim should avoid while fasting according to Ali ibn Abi Talib?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (a.s.) advises fasting individuals to avoid the bathhouse, cupping, and gazing at beautiful women, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on preserving both physical vitality and spiritual focus during the fast. These acts are seen as potential distractions or causes of weakness that may detract from the perfection (kamal) of the worship, aligning with the principle that fasting is not merely abstention from food but a holistic state of mindfulness.
